areaIter(path, railyard, types=None)

 

Iterator over areas of user type in types along path in railyard.

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) - The path along which areas are iterated.
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard containing the areas that are iterated.
  • types (Iterable(str) | str | none) - The user types that are the subtypes of the base type Area. Note that a string argument will be, interpreted as a 1-tuple, not as a character-iterable. An argument of None will be interpreted as "no restriction", i.e. all user subtypes of base type Area are considered.
Returns: Iterable(IGraph)
An iterator returning the areas (of user type in types) along path in railyard.

nodeConnectorIter(path)

 

Iterator over node-connectors of path.

A node-connector of a path is a 3-tuple (inIndex, node, outIndex) where inIndex and outIndex are the indices that connect to the two edges joined at the node in the path. When the node is the start (end) node of the path, the corresponding inIndex (outIndex) is None.

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) - The path from which node-connectors are iterated.
Returns: Iterable((int, INode, int))
An iterator returning the node-connector tuples of path.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

objectConnectorIter(path)

 

Iterator over object-connectors of path.

An object-connector of a path is a 3-tuple (index, obj, outIndex) where inIndex and outIndex are indices that connect to the two edges joined at the node containing obj in the path. Similar to nodeConnectorIter, when the node containing the obj is the start (end) node of the path, the corresponding inIndex (outIndex) is None.

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) - The path from which object-connectors are iterated.
Returns: Iterable((int, IRailyardComponent, int))
An iterator returning the object-connector tuples of path.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc
